title: Berean Standard Bible
edition: Standard text (no interlinear alignment, no Strong's numbers), 66 books
source: lyteword/bsb (GitHub repository, per-chapter Markdown transcription of the Berean Standard Bible; repository content dedicated to CC0 1.0 Universal)
underlying_text_source: bereanbible.com / berean.bible (the Berean Standard Bible project)
underlying_text_rights_statement: "The Berean Bible and Majority Bible texts are officially placed into the public domain as of April 30, 2023 ... Licensing is not required for any use." (quoted in the source repository's README, citing berean.bible/licensing.htm)

usage_permissions.note: Phase 9 (cip_core_content::UsagePermissions) - every permission below is true because BSB is a genuine CC0 1.0 public-domain dedication; see underlying_text_rights_statement above. Recorded on database/datasets/bsb/bsb.json's translation.usage and threaded into content_registry at import time.

checksum_algorithm: FNV-1a 64-bit over translation_id + every (book, chapter, verse, text) row, sorted, joined with '|' and newline-separated - see cip_integrations_bible::importer::compute_checksum
note_on_imported_at: The actual per-installation import timestamp is recorded dynamically in content_registry.imported_at at install time - this manifest is a static description of the dataset asset itself, not a record of any one installation.
